shots.seen: A real scoring act on the focused board (zoom 1.82): the top row of five placed cards lit, one beam each from the top edge, each pool as wide as its card and centred on it (printed: pool 94.7 px, card art 94.7 px, off centre 0.00), the card corners left dim; the rest of the board and the sidebar dimmed.
